description: Check whether an Omniseal sealed file shows signs of tampering. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

sealed_file.description: An explicitly supplied file. Provide exactly one HTTPS download URL or exact base64 bytes. Claude attachment IDs and local paths are not downloadable URLs.

name: verify_sealed_file
title: Verify sealed file
